### Load the relevant libraries

```{r}
journeys <- customer_journey %>%
  left_join(
    results,
    by = c("user_id", "session_id")
  );
journeys <- journeys %>%
  arrange(
    user_id,
    session_id,
    order
  )
journeys <- journeys %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  filter(runif(1) < 0.8) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Transition Calculations
channel_states <- c(
  "Direct",
  "Email Marketing",
  "Facebook",
  "Google Display",
  "Google Search",
  "Instagram",
  "Organic",
  "Youtube"
)

states <- c(
  channel_states,
  "Conversion"
)

train_conversion = journeys %>%
  filter(conversion == 1)

train_transitions <- train_conversion %>%
  group_by(
    user_id,
    session_id
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    order,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_state = lead(channel)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_state = if_else(
      is.na(next_state),
      "Conversion",
      next_state
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
transition_counts <- train_transitions %>%
  count(
    channel,
    next_state,
    name = "n"
  )
transition_probs <- transition_counts %>%
  group_by(channel) %>%
  mutate(
    probability = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
P <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(states),
  ncol = length(states),
  dimnames = list(
    states,
    states
  )
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(transition_probs))) {
  
  from <- transition_probs$channel[i]
  to   <- transition_probs$next_state[i]
  
  P[from, to] <-
    transition_probs$probability[i]
}
```

```{r}
### Explicitly Creating The Absorbing States
P["Conversion", ] <- 0

P[
  "Conversion",
  "Conversion"
] <- 1
### Meaning, once the conversion is reached, it remains converted.
```

```{r}
round(
  rowSums(P),
  10
)
```
```{r}
### Final Markov Object
customer_mc <- new(
  "markovchain",
  states = states,
  transitionMatrix = P,
  name = "Conditional Customer Conversion Journey"
)

customer_mc
```

```{r}
Q <- P[
  channel_states,
  channel_states
]

I8 <- diag(
  nrow(Q)
)

N <- solve(
  I8 - Q
)
```

```{r}
### Calculating The Expected Number of Steps
expected_steps <- as.numeric(
  N %*% rep(
    1,
    nrow(Q)
  )
)

names(expected_steps) <-
  rownames(Q)

expected_steps_table <-
  tibble(
    channel =
      names(expected_steps),
    
    expected_steps_to_conversion =
      expected_steps
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    expected_steps_to_conversion
  )
```

```{r}
### Stage 1 = Life cycle Classifications

# Define lifecycle boundaries
cutoffs <- quantile(expected_steps, c(1/3, 2/3))

# Classify marketing channels
channel_lifecycle <- tibble(
  channel = names(expected_steps),
  expected_steps = as.numeric(expected_steps)
) %>%
  mutate(stage = case_when(
    expected_steps <= cutoffs[1] ~ "Late",
    expected_steps <= cutoffs[2] ~ "Mid",
    TRUE ~ "Early"
  )) %>%
  arrange(expected_steps)

print(channel_lifecycle)
```
```{r}
### Stage 2 = Customer Classifications

# Identify each customer's latest recorded state
current_customers <- journeys %>%
  arrange(user_id, desc(session_id), desc(order)) %>%
  distinct(user_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(
    select(channel_lifecycle, channel, stage),
    by = "channel"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage = if_else(conversion == 1, "Converted", stage),
    stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Early", "Mid", "Late", "Converted"))
  )

# Summarise customer distribution
lifecycle_summary <- current_customers %>%
  count(stage, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n))

print(lifecycle_summary)
```
```{r}
ggplot(lifecycle_summary, aes(stage, percentage, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Customer Lifecycle Distribution",
    x = "Lifecycle Stage",
    y = "Percentage of Customers"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
# Calculate observed remaining steps within converting sessions
lifecycle_validation <- journeys %>%
  filter(conversion == 1) %>%
  group_by(user_id, session_id) %>%
  arrange(order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(actual_steps = n() - row_number() + 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    select(channel_lifecycle, channel, expected_steps, stage),
    by = "channel"
  ) %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Late", "Mid", "Early"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stage))

# Summarise observed journey lengths
validation_summary <- lifecycle_validation %>%
  group_by(stage) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_steps = mean(actual_steps),
    median_steps = median(actual_steps),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(validation_summary)
```
```{r}
ggplot(lifecycle_validation,
       aes(stage, actual_steps, fill = stage)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual Remaining Steps by Lifecycle Stage",
    x = "Predicted Lifecycle Stage",
    y = "Actual Steps Until Conversion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
stage_anova <- aov(actual_steps ~ stage, data = lifecycle_validation)

summary(stage_anova)
```
```{r}
ggplot(channel_lifecycle,
       aes(x = reorder(channel, expected_steps),
           y = expected_steps,
           fill = stage)) +
  
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(expected_steps, 4)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(channel_lifecycle$expected_steps) * 1.08)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Early" = "#E76F51",
      "Mid"   = "#E9C46A",
      "Late"  = "#2A9D8F"
    ),
    breaks = c("Early", "Mid", "Late")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Expected Steps to Conversion by Marketing Channel",
    subtitle = "Channels classified by predicted customer lifecycle stage",
    x = "Marketing Channel",
    y = "Expected Remaining Steps",
    fill = "Lifecycle Stage"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```
